init.title: Event Vision Options
init.description:
Select a category to view or update settings.

Known Limitations:
- Multi-camera visual fusion is experimental, disabled by default, and can issue additional Gemini requests with associated cost. It has not been live-tested on this Home Assistant installation.
- Cross-view correspondences are uncertain hypotheses, not identity proofs.
- Cloud responses do not block intake or capture; active analysis pins intentionally defer retention.
- Extracted frame UTC may remain unknown without verified camera clocks.
